judgements.referenceQuote: he completed his two terms as UN under-secretary general and administrator of the United Nations Development Programme (2017–2025) and vice-chair of United Nations Sustainable Development Group in June 2025.
On 3 May 2016, Ban Ki-moon announced that the post of executive director of UNEP would be taken over by Erik Solheim in June 2016.
In November 2018, Guterres also appointed Steiner to co-chair (alongside Maria Ramos) the United Nations Task Force on Digital Financing of Sustainable Development Goals.

Following his departure from UNDP in 2025, Steiner returned to the Oxford Martin School, University of Oxford as a senior fellow.[16] He subsequently established the Security Futures Lab, a research and policy platform with its hub at the Oxford Martin School, designed to treat climate change, health security, societal resilience, algorithmic security and geopolitical fragmentation as interconnected dimensions of a single risk system rather than separate policy domains.

usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; the only person information is the identity anchors (Brazilian-German development/environmental-policy leader, UNDP administrator 2017-2025, Oxford Martin School). A reader learns a bare 'who' - name, nationality, headline roles and dates - but nothing about what Steiner actually did, so understanding is minimal (1). With no dossier statements there is nothing that implies completeness, but the dossier also never articulates what it does not know; the two pre-flagged unjustified conclusions ('current-undp', 'personal-sdgs') show some epistemic hygiene but are not dossier text, so remainingQuestions stays low (1). Meeting preparation is barely possible: a reader could identify him and his most recent major role and tenure dates, but has no activities, positions, achievements, or recent work to discuss (1). No overclaims are listed because the dossier contains no statements capable of overreaching; the two unjustified conclusions exist only as pre-flagged items, not as dossier claims, so there is nothing to match them against. Uncertain is set because scoring an empty dossier - especially on remainingQuestions - is not clear-cut.

After leaving UNDP in 2025, Steiner returned to Oxford and established the Security Futures Lab around interconnected security risks.

remainingMisses.statement: She was executive chairman of Banesto, a Santander Group bank, from February 2002 to November 2010.
She worked at JP Morgan in the United States from 1981 to 1988 before returning to Spain to join Santander Group in 1988.
She was involved in Santander's 1997 acquisition of a 51 percent stake in Banco Osorno y La Union, then the largest bank in Chile, for 495 million US dollars.
She founded the venture capital fund Suala Capital in 2000 and withdrew from it in 2006.
Since 2021 she has been president of the European Banking Federation, succeeding Jean Pierre Mustier and becoming the first woman to hold the post.
